BiblicalUsage: Nasas means to raise a beacon or lift up a standard, and its only occurrence is a promise of rescue. In Zechariah 9:16 the Lord their God shall save His people in that day as the flock of His people, for they shall be as the stones of a crown, lifted up as an ensign upon His land.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a lifted ensign is a promise you can see from a long way off; God raises His people like a standard on a hill so that everyone knows whose they are.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
